scope: Retained original/new IQ object disassembly only. No compiler, linker, GPU, driver/model loading, service mutation or numerical-gate regrade. This is a prospective command contract, not proof of execution.

row1_review.meaning: First two identifiable target distributions match exactly. No assertion of later target rows, identical batch widths, hidden/KV/drafter states or sampling branches. Cold emitted divergence at index16 remains unexplained.

tool_contract.discovery: Parent may capture exact existing alias target/content hash then bounded --version and --help once; require matching installed CUDA13.3 documented capabilities. Do not assume alias resolves to previously pinned compiler directory, and do not install/change tools. Pin alias resolution/content before and after each data child.
tool_contract.why_new_pin: PREPARE20 tool identities cover nvcc/ptxas/etc but not cuobjdump. Exact hash not known locally and deliberately not invented.

official_reference.basis: NVIDIA CUDA13.3 Binary Utilities documents cuobjdump accepting host object files and dumping SASS, resource usage and ELF sections, with sm_80 architecture selection. No cubin extraction or nvdisasm required for first pass.

runner_requirements.guard: Before output/reservation and every child, fresh current canonical selected1853542/566f owner/idle/default/no phase/pending/build + root132; retain exact binding snapshot. Use already-qualified cooperative CPU reservation only if needed, ownPID release; never GPU lifetime lock or private maintenance window.
runner_requirements.during_child: Lightweight idle/phase/current-owner guard at existing supervisor interval; new user work or fault terminates only owned disassembler process group and preserves partial receipt. No native/user process signal.
runner_requirements.checks: Exact two object hashes and tool alias/resolved hash before/after each child. Preserve all argv/limits/stdout/stderr/rc and primary+cleanup errors. First timeout/overflow/parse fault HOLD; no silent limits relaxation, truncation or repeat.

comparison_contract.inventory: Inventory all functions from both outputs, one unambiguous SM80 code image each; absent/duplicate image/function or missing matching resource record is INCOMPLETE/HOLD. Preserve old-only/new-only/common sets and all raw text. New-only names must reconcile to explicit new IMMA functions, never blanket-ignore unknown additions/removals.
comparison_contract.first_pass: Compare complete per-function SASS blocks and resource records exactly after only outer formatting/line-ending normalization. Retain instruction address, register operands, predicates, immediates, machine encodings/control words, stalls, barriers, branch targets and padding. No arithmetic/scheduling normalization.
comparison_contract.ELF: Bind text section sizes, symbols, relocations, referenced constant bytes and function metadata. Different whole-object/fatbin layout is expected and is not itself a changed kernel. Any relocation-address normalization must be a separately reviewed mapping to identical resolved symbols/addends; first pass should report rather than erase differences.
comparison_contract.priority: All common functions included; highlight original fallback Q5_K column1/4/16, activation quantizers and other IQ kernels actually retained by selected source. Names discovered from exact mangled inventory, not guessed or fuzzy matched.
comparison_contract.not_proven: This cannot prove host dispatch equivalence, runtime numerical determinism, same inputs/batch shapes, absence of races or new IMMA correctness. Same SASS with different constant/relocation state is not executable equivalence. Differences do not themselves prove error.

source_causal_conclusion: Selected main andmodel were retained unchanged as old objects; only IQ translation unit was recompiled for candidate. Thus CUDA codegen changes in unchanged IQ functions are a useful distinct hypothesis.
N0 original-object control relink92 proves old object/link reproduction; it is not a recompile-original-IQ control. No such extra build/model trial is proposed here.

Same first two distributions and16 emitted tokens constrain the cold divergence, but do not locate first draft/proposal/confidence/batch-shape difference. Existing traces do not carry per-round drafts/width, so later flat-row comparisons stop.

Persistent RNG counter affects later requests; first cold starts counter0 in both. Distribution-preserving speculative sampling may use different acceptance/residual branches if drafts change. That does not meet frozen exact path gate.
reviewer_actions: Local receipt/source review and report preparation plus official13.3 documentation lookup. No disassembler/compiler/test/native/remote execution.
